notes:
Passed the gate on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null; no hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run. Entry symbols confirmed in the clone: safety_gymnasium.builder:Builder at safety_gymnasium/builder.py:55 and safety_gymnasium.utils.registration:make at safety_gymnasium/utils/registration.py:44. No deviation from the card: family-config with the GymnasiumDriver helper. The driver serves the standard Gymnasium view SafetyPointGoal1Gymnasium-v0 (README.md:547-554, safety_gymnasium/__init__.py:61-66, wrappers/gymnasium_conversion.py:26-34); native is Builder, which the registered task instantiates. The bridge derives cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1 and the action.values limit [-1, 1] from the fake's action space (point.xml:24-25); the package declares no Limit of its own and no operator-required bound, so there is no site-limits.example.json. The gate could not import safety-gymnasium, gymnasium, MuJoCo or numpy, and package code never imports the clone, so backends.fake is the package's pure Python kinematic Point Goal1 (fake.py), not MuJoCo. There is no array reduction: the fake returns the full 60-value flattened observation (12 sensor values plus a 16-bin lidar for the goal, the eight hazards and the vase). The fake was never compared with the upstream environment; the sim path (gymnasium.make of the registered id) was not run and additionally needs safety_gymnasium imported so that the Gymnasium id is registered. NOT COVERED: MuJoCo rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuator forces, gravity and meshes; the upstream frameskip of 10 physics steps of 2 ms per environment step (the fake advances one 20 ms tick); real sensor and lidar values (the fake's are analytic placeholders); rendering and vision observations; the vase contact and displacement cost; wall-clock pacing; and validation against the real environment. Snapshot and restore are not offered because Builder has no get_state/set_state. Expected warnings, none failing: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed for the next reset, so that class makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, action.values[*] and seed twice). There are no G4 warnings. Only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, all catalogue classes, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line of the last run.
